narrative.northStar: The Town With Its Walls Off
narrative.overview: Weir. is an 8-bit cutaway town: client's house, reviewers' hall, a lit door, the freelancer's studio, and under the pavement a pipe of coins. Every object wears a sign or a tiny label with a one-pixel pointer, so the scene explains itself without a feature grid. Product pages below are plain paper: pixel lettering for headings and controls, a smooth sans for reading, hyperlegible numerals for money. Yellow marks the thing to press; brick marks current page and focus. It rejects the split hero, the cream-serif default, soft shadows and rounded cards.
keyCharacteristics: Pixel plates (`assets/plates/*.png`, `image-rendering: pixelated`) with provenance sidecars
Pixel-bevel controls: 2px ink border, inset light/shade, no shadow, no radius
One motion: coins step along the pipe; nothing else moves
Colors
paper sky and a small pixel palette; yellow is rare and always actionable.
# Primary
**School-bus Yellow** (`yellow`): primary button, Connect wallet, selected options, coins. Lighter on hover, darker pressed.
**Ink** (`ink`): all text, every border, pressed tabs, the active mobile dot.
# Secondary
**Brick** (`brick`): brand period, current-nav underline, focus outline, the pause valve. Never a fill.
# Neutral

Paper** page; **Surface** panels, inputs, secondary buttons; **Sign** / **Wood** town plates (wood for money); **Muted** helpers; **Border** hairlines, idle dots; **Highlight** notices, secondary hover; **Subtle** disabled fills; **Error / Pending** status tints, always also in words.
# Named Rules
The One Yellow Rule.** Yellow is only a thing you can press or a coin.
The Ink Border Rule.** Edges are drawn in ink (2px on pages, 0.13–0.26cqw in the town), never implied by shadow.
Typography
Display Font:** Press Start 2P, self-hosted (Pixelify Sans, monospace fallbacks)
Body Font:** Alef (Avenir Next, system-ui)
Numeral Font:** Atkinson Hyperlegible, `tabular-nums slashed-zero`
# Hierarchy
**Display** (400, 2.6cqw, lh 1): the town headline; about 40px at 1536.
**Headline** (400, 1.9rem, lh 1.25; 2rem on phones): page `h1`, mobile town copy.
**Body** (400, 1rem, lh 1.55, max 72ch). **Small** (0.875rem): helpers, tables, page nav, footer.
**Control** (400, 0.7rem, lh 1.4): buttons; mobile nav 0.55rem.
**Town signs/labels**: 1.3–1.6cqw uppercase; labels 0.68–1.0cqw.
# Named Rules
The No-Faux-Bold Rule.** Press Start 2P ships one weight; headings and controls are 400, letter-spacing 0.
The Numerals Rule.** Amounts never render in the pixel face.
Layout

oduct pages: centred column `min(1120px, 100% - 64px)` (32px gutters below 640px), the 4px `spacing` scale, 1px section rules, two-column grids collapsing at 640px. The town is a 1536×1024 frame (`aspect-ratio`, `container-type: inline-size`); every box is a percentage measured from the approved comp. Breakpoints: **900px** (town becomes a strip), **640px** (single column).

ones (≤900px): the town's chrome and copy hide; a pixel top bar (2px ink rule) and scrolling pixel nav, headline and body as text, then the scene as a **1100px pannable strip** (513px tall, `scroll-snap-type: x proximity`), three 10px square dots (ink when current) and a full-width yellow Start a stream button.
Elevation & Depth

drop shadows. Depth is a pixel bevel: 2px ink border, `inset -2px -2px` shade, `inset 2px 2px` light (yellow: `#c98f00` / `#ffe08a`; white: `border` / white). Pressing shifts the control 1px down-right. The town layers plates by z-order.
The Flat-Pixel Rule.** No shadow that leaves the box; no blur; no gradient.
Shapes
uare corners wherever the world has landed; 1px ink pointer rules rotated 18–35°; rect-only pixel SVGs with `shape-rendering: crispEdges`. The two-arch mark is never redrawn.
Components
# Buttons

uare, 2px ink border, min-height 44px, pixel face 0.7rem. **Primary:** yellow fill and bevel; hover lighter; active darker plus 1px translate. **Secondary:** white, grey/white bevel, hover highlight. **Danger:** error text and border. **Text button:** underlined, no border. **Disabled:** subtle fill, muted text.
# Signs and labels (signature)

Sign:** `sign` plate, 0.2cqw ink border, uppercase pixel text; money signs on `wood`. **Label:** 0.13cqw border, name over figure; figures are stream #1's live numbers, else "(example)". **Pointer caption:** bare pixel text with a 1px rotated rule.
# Token picker / chips
uare secondary buttons in a 120px auto-fit grid; selected is yellow. Pressed tabs invert to ink.
# Cards / Containers
Form surface:** white, 2px ink border, square, 32px padding (24/20 on phones). **Terms box:** same, 16px, 72ch.
# Inputs / Fields
ite, 1px ink border, 11×12px padding, 1rem Alef; 0.875rem label above, muted helper below. Focus: 2px brick outline, 4px offset.
# Coin pipe (signature motion)
der `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` the coin row advances `translateX(0 → 5.2%)` in `steps(8, end)` over 4s, looping. Nothing else animates beyond the 120ms button colour transition.
Do's and Don'ts
# Do:
**Do** draw every control as a pixel bevel: 2px ink border, inset light/shade, square corners.
**Do** set amounts in Atkinson Hyperlegible, tabular slashed-zero.
**Do** say reviewers, deposit, terms, per day, settle, paused, closed.
# Don't:
**Don't** add drop shadows, blur, gradients or anti-aliased plate scaling.
**Don't** write oracle, hash, URI, attestation, bps, tier or rate per second outside a Details disclosure.
**Don't** ease or fade; motion is `steps()` under `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` only.
